latestAttribution.nextTest: Equip the armory camp's shield-breaking longbow on the ranger before retrying the heavy-shield stage.

latestAttribution.cause: Equipping the armor-breaking gloves on the warrior raised displayed equipped power from 523 to 630, a gain of 107.
latestAttribution.nextTest: Restore the berserker for more direct damage before retrying, because the bard's support-skill test succeeded but the bard ranked fourth in damage during the full defeat.

latestAttribution.cause: Equipping the shield-breaking axe on the warrior raised displayed equipped power from 389 to 523, a gain of 134.
latestAttribution.nextTest: Add the armory camp's armor-breaking gloves to the warrior's empty gloves slot before the retry, since armored enemies also survived the loss.

latestAttribution.cause: Equipping the shield-breaking longbow on the ranger raised displayed equipped power from 263 to 389, a gain of 126.
latestAttribution.nextTest: Equip the matching shield-breaking axe on the active warrior so two proven attackers can pressure the heavy shields before retrying.

latestAttribution.cause: Equipping the legendary level-14 helm on the warrior raised displayed equipped power from 158 to 263, a gain of 105.

hypotheses.cause: The bard may contribute through repeated team-support skills even without high personal damage.
